correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Type B reversibility normalization K column-stochastic generator, conductances w_ij=K_ij*pi_j, terminal masses alpha,beta and eliminated mass mu. For harmonic absorption probabilities p_s, the extension has C_sa=pi_s*p_s/alpha and C_sb=pi_s*(1-p_s)/beta. Its weighted Gram inversion yields -V_ab=alpha(z-q)/[alpha(beta+mu)-2alpha*z+q-z^2], z=sum pi_s*p_s and q=sum pi_s*p_s^2>=z^2/mu. At fixed z increasing q reduces the ratio; setting z=mu*r and optimizing v=r/(1-r) gives the claimed universal sharp bound and unique hitting probability ratio, attained by connected two-terminal stars. Strong maximum principle gives exact sign criterion for eliminated components touching both terminals. Uniform mass gives (n-2)/(2n) and beta->0 asymptotic is unbounded. Independent exact-rational matrices for twelve 3-state mass/edge combinations verified Gram relation, idempotence and coefficient inequalities. Finite samples do not prove all graphs.
